name: pdsls-alfred
description: AT Protocol utilities for Alfred — an Alfred port of the PDSls Raycast extension (pdsls.dev).

scripts.package: node build.mjs && rm -f PDSLS.alfredworkflow && cd workflow && zip -r -X ../PDSLS.alfredworkflow . -x '.*' 'info.json' && cd ..
